output_list.reason: ERC20 Token transfer vulnerability: Non-standard Return Pattern, Token transfer should always return false for failed transfers. In this contract, if _value > balanceOf[_from], the transfer would fail silently. This could be exploited by sending very large amount of tokens to a contract, where contract fails to handle tokens sent from owner. In this case tokens of owner would be forever locked. As a solution, make the function return bool success
